episodes.synopsis: Kagura has a boyfriend!! What unspeakable things will happen to him who appears before the obsessively nosey, restlessly agitated Umibozu and Gintoki!?
episodes.title: The Stairs to Adulthood May Not Always Lead Up

episodes.synopsis: Gintoki and Umibozu go all-out to stop Kagura's marriage from happening.
episodes.title: My Bald Dad, My Light-Haired Dad, and My Dad's Glasses

episodes.synopsis: Katsura, upon hearing Ikumatsu's story about an old man who used to visit her restaurant every New Year's Eve, enlists the Odd Jobs' help to look for him.
episodes.title: A Bowl of Ramen

episodes.synopsis: The gang discover the truth behind the old man and look to reunite him with Ikumatsu and her ramen.
episodes.title: A Family

episodes.synopsis: Hasegawa has a life-or-death encounter with assassins, and the Shinsengumi and Mimawarigumi compete over solving a fictional case.
episodes.title: Life, Death, and Shades / All the Answers Can Be Found in the Field

episodes.synopsis: The Odd Jobs encounter a strange sword at Tetsuko's smithy, and it grows attached (quite literally) to Gintoki's behind!
episodes.title: 3000 Leagues in Search of a Scabbard

episodes.synopsis: Kusanagi reveals the details of an old wound he received at the hands of the cursed sword, Maganagi, as Gintoki and Okita get ready for their duel. Meanwhile, Hijikata investigates Senbe the Manslayer.
episodes.title: The Super Sadist and the Super Sadist

episodes.synopsis: The Excaliburling story reaches its climax as Maganagi takes over Okita's body and reveals the truth to Kusanagi. How will Gintoki respond?
episodes.title: The Strongest Sword, and the Dullest Ass

episodes.synopsis: As group units take over the idol industry, Terakado Tsu must adapt or fall behind the times. But the idol she forms a combo unit with is... Kagura?
episodes.title: Wash Your Hands Before a Handshake

episodes.synopsis: Boogie Diamonds 48 has to deal with the sudden arrival of Galaxy Kingdom Bitches 48, who challenge them for the spot of Edo's top idol!
episodes.title: Diamonds are Unscratchable

episodes.synopsis: The battle at the Oedo Dome heats up as the fans waver between the two groups, but Otsu is still holed up indoors. Will she fade away, or will Shinpachi and gang rekindle her passion?
episodes.title: An Idol's Badge of Honor

episodes.synopsis: In the first half, Gintoki decides that as protagonist, he can't sit and do nothing as a Gintama game is released. He takes matters into his own hands as Odd Jobs looks to produce a super hit. In the second, Shinpachi buys a new pair of glasses that get him rather high spirits...
episodes.title: The Line Between Godlike Games and Shitty Games is Paper-Thin

episodes.synopsis: The Kabuki District Sports Meet begins, and Shinpachi bears witness to the influence guardian spirits have on such events. Will he be able to fight through it and help Odd Jobs win the cash prize?
episodes.title: Guardian Spirits Are Also a Part of the Soul
